title: Driftward Plateau
description: A grass-capped, fractured limestone plateau with exposed bedding and detached skyline fragments.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: no longer an inverted cone; several masses with stratified cliffs, a soil edge with hanging roots, trees, and a scale figure in the upper close-up. render_sheet.py change is fine (defaults unchanged for other assets). Not fixed: (1) all cliff faces are made of the same pillow-shaped bulging blocks in even rows (closeup_base tile, wire tile), so the body reads like stacked cushions or tyres instead of fractured stone; use flat, sharp-edged strata of varied thickness with vertical joints, overhangs and recesses. (2) The underside barely tapers and ends in a uniform fringe of small points; shape a clear asymmetric taper with a few large broken keels. (3) The detached fragments are rounded capsule/barrel shapes; make them angular broken chunks that match the strata of the main body. (4) The 330 m grass top is a smooth uniform green with a handful of 10 m trees; add grouped vegetation (tree clusters, shrubs, rock outcrops, paths) and soil/grass variation at this scale. (5) Cliff faces in closeup_upper are large flat low-poly facets with one dark painted stripe; model the crack instead.
